codexStages.slain: Moves: Pep Talk (burst radius 3 — BIG, get clear, slow windup). Pack hunter. Fears numbers — bring friends and it can't pick a target. Meat: tough but filling. The resonating sac makes a fine waterskin. You'll never hear 'you've got this' the same way again.

encounter.noticeText: "HELLO, CHAMPION!" It has noticed {who} too. It is SO EXCITED. You're all getting pep talks now.
encounter.painText: It winces mid-sentence — then rounds on {who}. "PAIN IS JUST WEAKNESS LEAVING THE BODY!"
encounter.proximityText: Too close. It whirls on {who}: "I BELIEVE IN YOU!" — proximity overrules the pep-talk queue.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client: FIFO encouragement queue, big slow burst (radius 3, windup 3 — get clear), deflates in a crowd. The encouragement is about to become physical.
encounter.knownCue: The pep talk is a weapon. Cover your ears or get out of range.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: Customer Service

attack.name: Please Hold
attack.telegraph: No telegraph. That's the point. One moment the night is quiet. The next, something is right behind you, and a syrupy voice says: 'Your fear is important to us.'

unknown: a voice in the dark: 'thank you for calling. your fear is important to us.'
vibe: it will help you with your problem. your problem is being alive near it
weaknesses: no telegraph — but it watches first (curious stance)
firelight reveals it before it rushes
it only rushes once — dodge the rush and it resets

edible.note: It is mostly headset. Do not eat the headset.

curious: "Hello? Are you still there?" It's watching. It's always been watching.
warn: "Please hold while we connect you to—" The voice cuts out. It's moving.
fearful: "We appear to be experiencing— experiencing—" The script breaks. The firelight is too much.

codexStages.unknown: Something called out to me last night. Polite. Professional. I ran anyway.
codexStages.observed: Ambush mimic. No telegraph on the rush — it just moves and hits, like the Hushpuppy, but smarter: it watches first (curious stance), learns your rhythm, THEN rushes. The voice is bait. The politeness is bait. Everything is bait.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Please Hold (rush — NO telegraph, it just goes). Counter: it spends 2-3 turns watching (curious) before rushing. Use those turns — get fire between you and it, or just leave. It only rushes once per approach. Parts: a working headset. The hold music is still playing. You can turn it off. You should turn it off.

encounter.noticeText: "Hello? Are you still there?" It's watching {who} now. It's always been watching.
encounter.adjText: Too close. "Please hold—" The voice cuts out. It's moving.
encounter.painText: The script breaks — and the syrupy voice fixes on {who}, curdling. Pain gets noticed.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client. THE WATCH: watching (2-3 turns of escalating politeness, no attack — your window: leave, or get fire near you) → dialing (ONE rush, no telegraph) → hold (resets, doesn't chase). Fire within 3 of the player suppresses the rush.
encounter.knownCue: It's stalling. The 'hold' is the attack — interrupt it.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: Terms & Conditions

attack.name: Binding Agreement
attack.telegraph: It unfolds — paper and ink and fine print, spreading across the ground toward you. Small text crawls up your legs. You can feel the clauses tightening. 'BY REMAINING IN PROXIMITY,' it rustles, 'YOU HAVE ACCEPTED.'

unknown: a drift of paper, moving against the wind
vibe: you already agreed to this. you agreed by existing near it
weaknesses: speed 1 — it is VERY slow, just walk away
fire. obviously. it's paper
never flees — but why would it need to

edible.note: Do not eat the contract.

curious: It rustles. Pages turning themselves. It's reading YOU.
warn: "SECTION 7, SUBSECTION C..." The text is crawling closer. You should move.
fearful: The pages curl, blacken at the edges. Even contracts fear fire.

codexStages.unknown: The papers by the creek arranged themselves into paragraphs. I didn't read them. I left.
codexStages.observed: Paper golem. The System discovered human legal documents and found them DELIGHTFUL — binding agreements without consent! It built one. The attack locks on (direct, range 3, undodgeable by movement). But it's speed 1. The slowest thing in the woods. Just... walk away. It's paper. Fire ends it.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Binding Agreement (direct, range 3 — moving won't dodge it, but WALKING AWAY will, it's speed 1). 70-90 HP, never flees. The joke is that it's terrifying and trivial at once. Burn it. Loot the vellum — real paper is worth more than gold out here.

encounter.noticeText: Pages turn themselves toward {who}. It's reading you.
encounter.adjText: Too close. Fine print crawls toward {who} — proximity is consent.
encounter.painText: It rustles — and the text re-orients on {who}. Pain gets noticed.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client. THE FINE PRINT: speed 1 — just walk away. unfold (spreads, 1 tile/turn) → clause (1st consecutive turn in range 3: the text tightens) → bound (2nd consecutive turn: Binding Agreement declared, direct/range 3, undodgeable). Leaving resets the clause. Never flees. Torch ×3 (it's paper).
encounter.knownCue: Read the fine print — it telegraphs where the binding lands. And bring fire.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

terraformDesc: Sheds legal documents. The ground becomes difficult terrain (paper cuts).

name: Middle Manager

attack.name: Circle Back
attack.telegraph: It paces a wide circle around you, dictating into nothing: "Per my last roar..." The circle tightens. It's not asking. It's telling.

pattern.chargeDesc: Circles wide, then charges from the flank. The telegraph is the circling — the charge comes from where you aren't looking.

unknown: something pacing in circles, muttering about action items
vibe: it doesn't do the violence itself. it DELEGATES. to itself. repeatedly
weaknesses: wide charge (width 2) — but it announces the line
it can't handle groups (fears numbers)
fast but predictable — it always circles first

edible.note: Surprisingly good. Tastes like corner office.

curious: "Let's sync up!" It's circling. It's always circling.
warn: "I'm going to have to ask you to bleed." The circle tightens. Here it comes.
fearful: "Too many stakeholders! Parking this! Parking this!" It backs off from the crowd.

codexStages.unknown: There's a thing in the woods that schedules meetings. I declined.
codexStages.observed: Pack alpha. The System watched human hierarchies and built the perfect middle predator: fast, circling, delegating violence to itself. The charge is WIDE (width 2) — harder to sidestep than the Bulldozer's. But it always circles first. Watch the circle. Read the line.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Circle Back (charge, length 4, WIDTH 2 — sidestep further than you think). Pack hunter, speed 5, fears crowds. The telegraph is the circling — it always does one full loop before charging. Use it. Meat: excellent. The tiny tie is worth a fortune in trade. Nobody knows why.

encounter.noticeText: It adds {who} to the meeting invite. "LOOPING IN — attendance mandatory." You're all on the agenda now.
encounter.painText: It snorts — then squares on {who}. "PER MY LAST ROAR: pain gets prioritized."
encounter.proximityText: Too close. It pivots to {who}: "LET'S TAKE THIS OFFLINE." Proximity overrules the agenda.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client: FIFO meeting agenda, always circles first (announcing the charge), wide locked line (width 2 — sidestep far), post-charge debrief. The line it announces is the line it charges.
encounter.knownCue: It circles to cut off escape. Keep your back to open ground.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: Inspiration

attack.name: Eureka
attack.telegraph: It sits perfectly still, glowing brighter and brighter. A beautiful idea, taking shape. You can feel the brilliance building. That's when you realize: ideas this bright are never safe to stand next to.

pattern.burstDesc: It glows brighter and brighter. When it flares white, it detonates. RUN.

unknown: a light in the dark that wasn't there yesterday
vibe: it seemed like a good idea at the time
weaknesses: it glows — you can see it coming
burst radius 2 — back off when it brightens
daylight disperses it (fears daylight)
never moves once set — just don't approach

edible.note: It is a lightbulb with teeth. Do not eat it.

parts: a faint smell of ozone and genius

curious: It brightens slightly as you approach. It likes the attention.
warn: The glow is intensifying. The air tastes like copper. This is the part where you run.
fearful: Dawn touches it and the light gutters, thins. It was never meant for daytime.

codexStages.unknown: There was a light in the woods last night. Beautiful. I didn't go toward it. Good.
codexStages.observed: Detonation predator. Like the Speedbump it sits perfectly still — but where the Speedbump snaps, this DETONATES. Burst radius 2, the hardest-hitting burst in either wave. The tell is the brightening: 2 beats from glow to boom. It fears daylight — it only sets its ambush at night.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Eureka (burst radius 2, 22-34 damage — the biggest burst so far, telegraphed by brightening). It never moves once placed. The counterplay is simple: see the glow, don't approach, wait for dawn. It seemed like a good idea at the time. Parts: filament (excellent fire-starter), glass, and the lingering feeling you almost did something stupid.

encounter.noticeText: The light swivels toward {who}. It likes being looked at.
encounter.adjText: Too close. The glow flares around {who} — it's been noticed.
encounter.painText: It flickers — and the light fixes on {who}, hardening. Pain gets noticed.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client. THE BRIGHTENING: settle (drifts until a foe is within 4, then SETS — never moves once set) → brighten (2 beats, escalating, holds position) → bloom (burst radius 2, 22-34) → ember (2 turns spent, harmless). Daylight disperses it.
encounter.knownCue: It glows brighter before detonation. When it flares, RUN.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

terraformDesc: Detonation leaves a scorched crater. The ground remembers.

name: Nostalgia

attack.name: Home Movies
attack.telegraph: It unfolds a screen of light between the trees. And there — impossibly — is home. Your street. Your kitchen. Someone you miss, laughing. You take a step closer without deciding to. The light has edges. The edges are sharp.

unknown: a flickering light at dusk, showing... something. you couldn't look away
vibe: it shows you what you miss. the missing is the trap
weaknesses: the beam is a straight line — sidestep
it fears movement — keep moving, break the spell
it watches first — leave during the curious phase

edible.note: It is a projector. Do not eat the projector.

parts: reels of film (your memories? don't watch)

curious: The light flickers. Shapes resolve. Is that... is that home?
warn: "STAY AWHILE," hums the light. The image sharpens. The edges sharpen too.
fearful: The image judders, breaks up. You're moving too fast. It can't hold the picture.

codexStages.unknown: At dusk I saw my street. My actual street. I stood there for I don't know how long.
codexStages.observed: Memory lure. The System mined your homesickness and built a projector for it. It shows you home — real footage, somehow — and while you stand there aching, it fires a beam along the line of your gaze. Windup 2. The cruelty is the point. The audience wept. (The audience loved it.)
codexStages.slain: Moves: Home Movies (beam length 5, windup 2 — the line follows your gaze, so MOVE). It fears movement: keep walking and the image can't hold. It spends turns watching (curious) — that's your window to leave. The reels it drops show your memories. Don't watch them. Or do. The System already did.

encounter.noticeText: The light finds {who}. Shapes resolve. Is that... home?
encounter.adjText: Too close. The screen swings toward {who} — the picture sharpens.
encounter.painText: The image tears — and the projector swings to {who}. Pain gets noticed.
encounter.comment: Encounter framework client. THE SPELL: watch (2 turns, curious — leave now) → spell (Home Movies declared: beam length 5, windup 2, aim locked; the light PULLS a still target 1 tile/turn toward it; moving 2+ tiles breaks the spell) → static (1 turn, confused). It fears movement.
encounter.knownCue: The picture holds you still. Keep moving and it can't lock on.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: ducks in a row
vibe: a line of muscovy ducks, head to tail, moving as one. Break the line and you have two problems.
telegraph: The ducks stop quacking. All heads turn toward you at once.

tactics.observed: Kill from the tail forward. Break the middle and it splits into two snakes.
tactics.slain: Contact burns — every segment is a mouth. Don't let it touch you. Don't touch it.

attack.name: bite
attack.telegraph: The heads turn toward you.

encounter.knownCue: They're organized. Break the formation — isolate one.

name: Glasswing Darter

attack.name: Skyfall Dive
attack.telegraph: A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you.

weaknesses: move when the shadow comes — it can't turn mid-dive
after a miss it lands, vulnerable for a turn

edible.note: Dragonfly the size of a hawk. Gamey. The wings are like cellophane.

parts: glasswing membrane (light, strong — good for patching)

codexStages.unknown: A shadow that wasn't a cloud. Then the air screamed.
codexStages.observed: Glasswing darter. The System gave a dragonfly hawk eyes and no fear of heights. It circles high, picks a target, and falls like a thrown knife. The shadow is the warning — move.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Skyfall Dive (telegraphed by shadow, dodge by moving, big damage if it connects), Grounded (after a miss, it's vulnerable 1 turn). Kill it when it lands. The membranes make excellent patches.

unknown: a shadow moving wrong against the sun
vibe: territorial — the sky is its, and you're under it

curious: A high whine, circling. It's looking down at you.
warn: The shadow detaches from the clouds and starts growing.

encounter.comment: Daytime diver. Circles high (untargetable), shadow telegraphs dive, dodge by moving, vulnerable when grounded after miss.
encounter.knownCue: Watch the shadow, not the bug. Move when it grows.

threatLines.notice: A whine from overhead. The glasswing is circling {who}.
threatLines.pain: It shrieks — wings buzzing angry — and climbs higher. It's not done.
threatLines.snap: The shadow detaches. It's coming straight down at {who}.

weaknesses: attack it while it basks — it loses the charge
it won't fight in shade or at dusk

parts: sunbasker scales (retain heat — good for cold nights)

codexStages.unknown: Something gold in the grass. It wasn't there, then it was.
codexStages.observed: Sunbasker. The System took a collared lizard and made it solar-powered. It basks to charge — each turn in sunlight makes the next bite worse. Break the bask (hit it, shade it) and it's just a lizard.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Bask (charges in sunlight, +damage per turn), Sun-Charged Bite (damage scales with charge). Interrupt the bask. Fight it in shade. The scales hold heat for hours.

unknown: a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
vibe: territorial — it was here first, and the sun is its

curious: A rustle in the grass. Something gold catches the light.
warn: Its scales are going gold. It's charging.
fearful: It flattens, dull brown, trying to disappear into the dirt.

encounter.comment: Solar charger. Basks to build damage, interrupt resets it. Weak in shade/dusk.
encounter.knownCue: Don't let it bask. Hit it every turn or drag it to shade.

threatLines.notice: Gold in the grass. The sunbasker is watching {who}.
threatLines.pain: It hisses — gold flaking to brown — and scrambles for the sunlight.
threatLines.snap: Fully gold now. It's coming at {who}, molten and furious.

terraformDesc: Where it basks, the grass blackens. Solar charge scorches the earth.
